title.en: DSH Plugin Market · curated by 插件市场deepseek
title.zh: DSH 插件市场 · 人工审核版

description.en: Human-reviewed index for DeepSeek Harness plugins. Only entries whose package declares a bundle patch are listed.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工审核插件索引；仅收录在 package.json 中声明了 bundle patch 的包。

title.zh: 分类由关键词自动推断
鲸挑细选 · 同需求多方案对比

description.en: Run one request as 2-4 parallel variants in the main conversation, compare answers, files or live pages, then adopt the one you prefer.
description.zh: 把同一个需求交给 2–4 个版本并行做，在主对话里比较回答、文件和可运行网页，盲选或公开对比后再采纳。

description.en: Turns SSH hosts into DSH workspaces: remote file tree, highlighted editing, recursive search, terminals and Git diffs, with the agent working in the remote directory.
description.zh: 把 SSH 主机变成 DSH 工作区：远程文件树、高亮编辑、递归搜索、终端与 Git 差异，Agent 直接在远端目录里读写、构建和测试。

description.en: Per-session, per-model cost and token accounting, with a 170+ model price catalogue, subscription-quota lookups, budgets and peak/off-peak reminders.
description.zh: 按会话与模型统计费用和 Token，内置 170+ 模型价格目录，可查多家订阅额度，并支持预算提醒与峰谷时段提示。

title.zh: 免 Key 多引擎搜索

description.en: Registers a web-search provider with 40 switchable engines and automatic fallback, so search no longer depends on the official DeepSeek key.
description.zh: 注册一个可切换 40 个引擎的搜索 provider 并自动回退，让 web_search 不再依赖 DeepSeek 官方 API key。

title.zh: 分层记忆与上下文编排

description.en: Layered, inspectable memory for DSH: working memory, project archives and long-term evidence, with pluggable sources, strategies and nine storage backends.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的分层、可见记忆：工作记忆、项目档案与长期证据分离，来源与策略可插拔，本地存储或接入 8 种第三方 Provider。

description.en: Bridges CursorTouch/Windows-MCP into DSH through the built-in MCP client: screenshots, UI automation, input, clipboard, processes and registry, gated by a per-session switch.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 自带 MCP 桥接入 Windows-MCP：截屏、UI 自动化、输入、剪贴板、进程与注册表，默认关闭且按会话授权。

description.en: Archive, restore, favourite and permanently delete sessions, search archived message bodies, and clean up orphaned subagents.
description.zh: 归档、恢复、收藏和永久删除会话，支持正文全文检索与快速预览，并能清理孤儿子代理。

description.en: Turns a video into one addressable contact-sheet image with timestamps and ASR lines, so a text model can cite frames and zoom into a few seconds.
description.zh: 把视频压成一张可寻址的宫格图，带时间戳与台词，纯文本模型因此能引用某一格、再放大看某几秒。

description.en: Eight original skins plus wallpaper, accent colour and shareable theme packs, implemented purely on the native --dsw-* token surface.
description.zh: 8 套原创皮肤，外加壁纸、强调色与可分享主题包，全部走原生 --dsw-* token，不注入、不改安装包。

description.en: An interactive terminal UI for DSH sessions: streaming markdown, tool cards, slash and @ completion, history search, and a pixel-whale header.
description.zh: 在终端里跑 DSH 会话：流式 Markdown、工具卡片、斜杠与 @ 补全、历史搜索，外加像素鲸鱼首页。
